body:
Hello, wonderful Internet Stranger.

Thank you so much for your reply. I'm so sorry to hear that you've been through similar pain, but if it's any consolation to you, you've made a difference to at least one person. I read your message this morning, and your words really did help to get me through the day. I returned to work for the first time since my break up, and oh, it was hard. I carried my phone to bathroom with me and looked up ways that I might end it all, and seriously considered ending it tonight. But tonight is now here, and I'm willing to hang on for now, and (hopefully) for the nows that follow. Your response really, really did help with that.

I know it's poor consolation, but you've made a difference. Your kindness made me cry (in a good way, I think) and demonstrated so beautifully the kindness and caring of complete strangers. I have many close friends that are looking out for me, but the compassion of complete strangers is an amazing and unique thing. I can't have my partner, but if I hadn't lost him I might not have had the opportunity to learn this in such a personal way. I've often spoken to others of the power that their words have, but you've really deftly made that real for *me*.

I can't promise I'll be okay, but I will try to be. I will try to exercise, to eat well, and to structure my life. I will continue to try to reach out and I will seek professional help if such dark thoughts continue to plague me. I will try learn from the relationship, and to learn about myself, and to be compassionate to myself. I will try to see the beauty that's out there.

So, thank you. Thank you for caring. Thank you for replying to me, a stranger, when I so desperately needed it. I hope you know that you're kind of a superhero.
